96fb5cfccc089f9db6f13f7c322ed9e18dd66fc7.summary: Mandiant's annual M-Trends 2026 report, drawn from over 500,000 hours of 2025 incident investigations. It reports exploits as the top initial access vector (32%), voice phishing rising to 11%, and the hand-off from initial access to secondary groups falling to 22 seconds. Median dwell time rose to 14 days. Ransomware groups target backups and hypervisors, and espionage actors persist on edge devices (BRICKSTORM dwell nearly 400 days). The report notes AI-linked malware such as PROMPTFLUX, PROMPTSTEAL and QUIETVAULT, but says 2025 breaches were not directly the result of AI.

96b349492a25c6149912b81dab44e1f3daac8463.summary: Educational tutorial by a blogger showing how to dump the Windows LSASS process memory to a file with a small C++ program that calls the MiniDumpWriteDump API, as an alternative to Mimikatz. The post says the technique is used by APTs and tools such as Cobalt Strike, and names Fox Kitten and HAFNIUM as having used a related dumping tool. It also notes that Windows Defender flagged Mimikatz but allowed the dumper to run.

96ceefd1027aca44cad0ada5de630d01bacfc012.summary: Dell SecureWorks researchers unveiled a report at the Black Hat conference on a newly detected hacking group, Threat Group 3390, nicknamed Emissary Panda, believed to be based in China. Its main method was watering hole attacks using over 100 compromised legitimate websites. Targets included automotive, aerospace, energy and pharmaceutical firms, defense contractors, universities, law firms, political organizations and government agency websites.
